Lilian’s favorite part of being a welder fabricator apprentice with JKET North America is getting to work with her mentor. Through practicing skills, life lessons, and even making mistakes, Lilian reflects on how there is no substitution for on-the-job experience. Apprenticeships offer learning experiences beyond the classroom! #NationalApprenticeshipWeek

After 76 days of Democrat obstruction, funding for DHS has finally been sent to President Trump’s desk for his signature. Thank you to Secret Service, TSA, Coast Guard, FEMA, and CISA personnel for your service while Democrats played politics with your livelihoods and America’s national security.

ICE and CBP next!
